questions.question: Which of the following chemical compounds is a naturally occurring orange/yellow pigment extracted from turmeric, which is used as a spice, in food colouring and as a traditional herbal medicine?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Curcumin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Curcumin** is the active ingredient of the dietary spice** turmeric** and is extracted from the **rhizomes of C. longa**, a plant in the Zingiberaceae family.
 
• **Curcuma longa** has been traditionally used in Asian countries as a medical herb due to its **antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimutagenic, antimicrobial and anticancer properties.**
 
• **Turmeric's** color comes mainly from **curcumin,** a bright yellow phenolic compound that has been in the news for its ostensible potential to** fight cancer**. As a result, the demand for turmeric with high curcumin content has risen.
 
• **India** is the** largest producer** and **exporter of turmeric** in the world. Turmeric occupies about 6% of the total area under spices and condiments in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cochineal**: The **cochineal** is a scale insect in the suborder Sternorrhyncha, from which the natural **red-coloured pigment** **carmine** is derived. **Carminic acid** is extracted from **female cochineal insects** and is treated to produce **carmine.**
 
• **Tartrazine**: **Tartrazine** is a synthetic** lemon yellow dye **primarily used as a** food colouring**. It can also be used with brilliant blue or green to produce various green shades.
 
• **Carmoisine**: **Carmoisine (E122) is a food colour** that is made from** coal tar**. It is a **red dye** that is used to add color to food products.

questions.question: In which year was the first reliable measurement on the properties of gases made by Anglo-Irish scientist Robert Boyle?

__
 
• **Robert Boyle** published an **experimental law** in** 1662 **that describes how the **pressure of a gas tends to decrease as the volume of the container increases**.
 
• **Boyle's Law:** ​
 
 
• **The absolute pressure exerted by a given mass of an ideal gas is inversely proportional to the volume it occupies if the temperature and amount of gas remain unchanged within a closed system. **
 
• **Mathematically**, Boyle's law can be stated as:
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/media/math/render/svg/36e185ae17420ddc45220bfc1572201e27f4131d] ,

 
• Pressure is inversely proportional to the volume.
 
• where **P **is the **pressure** of the gas, **V **is the **volume** of the gas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robert Boyle** was elected a **Fellow of the Royal Society (FRS) in 1663**.
 
• **Barometer i**s a scientific instrument** used to measure atmospheric pressure**.

questions.question: In which year was Soil Health Card launched in India to enable the farmers to apply appropriate recommended dosages of nutrients for crop production and improving soil health and its fertility?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Soil Health Card** __: 

 __
 
• The **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare** introduced the scheme on **December 5, 2015.**
 
• Soil Health Card (SHC) is a **printed report** which contains the nutrient status of soil in relation to **12 nutrients**: pH, Electrical Conductivity, Organic Carbon, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulphur, Zinc, Boron, Iron, Manganese and Copper of farm holdings.
 
• SHC is provided to all or any farmers within the country at an interval of **three years** to enable the farmers to use recommended doses of nutrients supported soil test values to appreciate improved and sustainable soil health and fertility, low costs and better profits. Farmers can track their soil samples and also obtain their Soil Health Card report.
 
• It is a **field-specific detailed report of soil fertility status and other important soil parameters** that affects the productivity of the crop.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **National Productivity Council (NPC)**, the Soil Health Card scheme has led to a **decline of 8-10%** in the use of chemical fertilizers and also **raised productivity by 5-6%.**
 
• Issuance of the Soil Health Cards has enabled the farmers to know the soil health parameters and improve their productivity by judicious application of soil nutrients.
 
• Agriculture Minister of India - **Shri Narendra Singh Tomar**. (Sept 2022)
 
• Other Schemes under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare are -** Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana** **(PMFBY)**, **Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS), Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS) **and** Pilot Unified Package Insurance Scheme (UPIS).**

questions.question: How many members of the State Legislative Council are nominated by the Governor?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** One-sixth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **State Legislative Council** referred to as **Vidhan Parishad**, is the **upper house** in those states of India that have a **bicameral state legislature*** *whereas* *the **lower house** is the State** Legislative Assembly**.

 
 
• There are **6 states** that have a State Legislative Council. These are **Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana, Maharashtra, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The size of the State Legislative Council **cannot be more than one-third of the members of the State Legislative Assembly**. But,the minimum number of members **cannot be less than 40 members.**
 
 
 
• **Compositions__**- 
 __
 
• **One third of member** of the council are elected by the members of local bodies such as **municipalities, Gram panchayats, Panchayat samitis and district councils.**
 
• **One third of member** are elected by the** members of Legislative Assembly** of the State from among the persons who are not members of the State Legislative Assembly.
 
• **One sixth member are nominated by the Governor **from the persons having knowledge or practical experience in fields such as literature, science, arts, the cooperative movement and social services.
 
• **One twelfth member** are elected by persons **who are graduates** of three years' standing as residents of that state.
 
• **One twelfth member** are elected by **teachers** who had at least three years of experience in teaching in educational institutions within the state not below secondary schools, including colleges and universities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The State Legislative Assembly**, also known as **Vidhan Sabha** is a legislative body in the states and union territories of India. In the 28 states and 3 union territories with having a** unicameral state legislature**, it's the only legislative body and in **6 states it is the lower house legislature** with the upper house being the State Legislative Council.
 
• The House strength of** Bihar** is the highest- **243.**
